tools.name: atlas_kit
tools.description: The direction kit for a character state: beat-by-beat behaviour fitted to the shot size (where the tell can be seen), eye life, breath, the target model's rules and a voice delivery line. Write the acting prose from it, then atlas_lint the prose. Paid: $0.10 per call via x402 (USDC on Base), or prep

tools.name: atlas_draft
tools.description: A first-draft acting paragraph assembled from the kit and fitted to the target's character cap, already linted. It reads mechanically: rewrite it as prose. A voice target gets the delivery line instead. Paid: $0.10 per call via x402 (USDC on Base), or prepaid credits with an API key (`Authorization:

tools.name: atlas_lint
tools.description: Check an acting paragraph or voice direction before spending credits: emotion labels, mugging, looks into the lens, quoted speech on hosts that block it, a tell bigger than the state allows, and the target's character cap. ok is true when there are no errors; each finding carries its fix. Free.

tools.name: atlas_search
tools.description: Full-text search across behaviour cues, FACS action units, expressions, display strategies, emotions, situations, modifiers, model notes and targets. Search by emotion or situation; what comes back is behaviour. Free.

tools.name: atlas_show
tools.description: One atlas record by id (or an emotion by name), with the records that use it. Free.

tools.name: atlas_targets
tools.description: The target models the atlas knows, with each prompt field's character cap and what the model needs. Pass a target id to atlas_kit, atlas_draft and atlas_lint. Free.

tools.name: atlas_journey
tools.description: A character's arc beat by beat, with continuity flags: reset (intensity drops with no event), breach (a hidden feeling shown to the person it's hidden from), overshoot (a tell bigger than the feeling) and flat (beats that never change). Fields a beat leaves out carry over from the beat before. Free.

tools.name: atlas_buy_pack
tools.description: Buy 20 paid calls for $1.00 in one x402 payment (USDC on Base). Returns an API key: send it as an `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header (or in params._meta["creatinginai/pack"]) on atlas_kit or atlas_draft instead of paying per call. Each successful call uses one credit; failed calls are free.
